construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored in this isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: fixture_label; feedback[{id,text}]; documents[{id,text,feedback_ids}]; questions[{id,text}]; theme_rules{name:[keywords]}; required_fields[snake_case]
shared_schema.output: {schema_version,status,stage,data}; data accumulates context, classified feedback, themes, checked records, and evidence answers
shared_schema.validation: One validate function enforces input types, unknown fields, unique IDs, references and deterministic handoff provenance. JSON loading rejects duplicate keys and non-finite constants.
shared_schema.errors: CLI emits one JSON object with status error and exits 2 for validation, decoding or file errors. Document quality issues are explicit needs_review records, not fatal input errors.

cross_stage_handoffs.consumes: Validated feedback classifications and theme aggregation with source context
cross_stage_handoffs.produces: Normalized key-value fields, quality checks and feedback-linked themes

cross_stage_handoffs.consumes: Validated document records; needs_review records are excluded from evidence
cross_stage_handoffs.produces: Question-specific evidence excerpts, source IDs, propagated themes and suggested actions

behavior: Synthetic fixtures are explicitly labeled; no live data retrieval or provider calls.
Configurable multi-label theme keyword sets; unmatched feedback becomes other.
Sentiment uses whole ASCII token polarity counts; mixed equal counts are neutral.
Theme priority sorts by negative mentions, count and name; counts represent feedback rows, not unique customers.
Documents extract line-based key: value fields, normalize field names, retain the first duplicate value and flag duplicates or missing required values.
Research ranks checked source documents by distinct query-token overlap and document ID, preserves exact source excerpts and abstains without matches.
Each stage validates the prior stage before processing. Final output retains provenance and all intermediate results.
No LLM step is needed or implemented; no nondeterministic summaries are generated.

test_outcomes.cli_output: One valid JSON object with status ok, stage research and three answers
test_outcomes.deliverable_check: Exactly the four specified files; no bytecode or scratch artifacts
